verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs describe background cloud agents for clearing a bug backlog, exploring design variations in parallel, and giving every board task its own isolated sandbox, which implies tasks can run concurrently. The docs never explicitly state how many agent tasks can run at once or describe throughput scaling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent task execution and its limits, concurrency or throughput controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Clear your bug backlog with background cloud agents
every task on your board its own full-stack environment: an isolated sandbox with a branched database when needed
launch our agents in the cloud. LightSprint tracks all PRs and manages ticket state
